articleBlocks: Bandai Namco made me think of video games, while Hasbro is a huge corporation with many divisions.
The initial impression was a broad category of 'entertainment companies'.
However, that theory broke down as I looked closer.
Steiff, with its classic stuffed animals, felt out of place in a general entertainment category.
The 'Steiff' clue was the turning point.
It forced me to reconsider the common thread.
That's when I realized they are all toy companies.
Each clue represents a major player in the toy industry.
Looking back, the focus on physical products and collectibles makes the answer clear.
The specific connection unites them more cleanly than other possible readings.
solutionNarrative: Steiff and Lego first pulled me toward entertainment companies, so that was the first path I tested. It held together for a moment, but steiff never really fit it. The more I pushed that first read, the more the board sounded stitched together instead of naturally solved.

The solve turned when I stopped treating steiff as just another clue and asked what kind of thing each clue could really be describing. Once I made that shift, I was no longer thinking about entertainment companies; I was checking whether the earlier clues all behaved like parts of the same real set. That was when the answer became clear, because the remaining clues stopped feeling like separate trivia and started reinforcing the real category.
